title: dev-04: Model — Recipe structural types
description: Implement Recipe, Section, Content, Step, and Item in Recipe.swift. Recipe aggregates Metadata, [Section], [Ingredient], [Cookware], [Timer]. Section has name: String? and content: [Content]. Content is an enum with .step(Step) and .text(String). Step has items: [Item]. Item is an enum with .text(String), .ingredient(index: Int), .cookware(index: Int), .timer(index: Int). All types are Sendable and Equatable.
acceptance_criteria: public struct Recipe: Sendable, Equatable with metadata: Metadata, sections: [Section], ingredients: [Ingredient], cookware: [Cookware], timers: [Timer] is declared.
public struct Section: Sendable, Equatable with name: String? and content: [Content] is declared.
public enum Content: Sendable, Equatable with .step(Step) and .text(String) is declared.
public struct Step: Sendable, Equatable with items: [Item] is declared.
public enum Item: Sendable, Equatable with .text(String), .ingredient(index:Int), .cookware(index:Int), .timer(index:Int) is declared.
